backend/main.mo: Main actor defining types (ShopOpening, Product) and state for shop openings, products, testimonials, and baking tips with query/update functions for each.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that initializes empty lists for shopOpenings, products, testimonials, and bakingTips when upgrading from an empty OldActor state.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON mapping of frontend file paths to their descriptions, documenting all React components and styling files for the luxury bakery website.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color variable definitions for light and dark themes, including custom luxury palette colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference to main.tsx for the Crème Patisserie application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component assembling Header, all content sections (Hero, Why, Testimonials, Menu, Celebration, Location, FinalCTA), and Footer into single-page layout.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationSecti: Section displaying four celebration occasions (birthdays, anniversaries, gifts, corporate) with emoji icons over a background image.
Final call-to-action section with background image, headline, and Order Now button that scrolls to location section.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with copyright, caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking, and heart icon in gold color.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with bakery name and Order Now button that changes appearance on scroll with backdrop blur effect.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with cafe background image, headline, subtext, badge, and two CTA buttons for ordering and visiting.
Contact section displaying address, hours, phone with icons, plus Get Directions and Call Now action buttons.
frontend/src/components/MenuHighlightsSe: Displays a grid of five signature menu items (cupcakes, brownies, Korean bun, custom cakes, celebration boxes) with images, descriptions, badges, and buttons to view the full menu or order online.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Shows a 4.9-star rating section with two customer testimonials displayed in styled cards with star ratings and customer names.
frontend/src/components/WhySection.tsx: Presents a "More Than A Bakery" section highlighting four key features (premium ingredients, beautiful presentation, perfect for gifting, loved by Jhansi) in a grid layout with checkmark icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor instance, switching between authenticated and anonymous actors based on Internet Identity login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines the global CSS with Tailwind directives, custom OKLCH color palette (cream, blush, chocolate, gold), font imports (Playfair Display, Inter), and utility classes for the bakery theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom OKLCH colors (cream, blush, chocolate, gold), semantic color mappings, custom fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), border radius, and shadow utilities.
project_state.json: Project metadata indicating this is version 2 modifications for a luxury bakery website with one pending feature request (AR-1) to modify the existing site based on upcoming specifications.
